import os, json

policy_path = '/tmp/verification-policy.json'

print("policy exists:", os.path.exists(policy_path))
print()

# Recheck /tmp contents in case anything was staged after our last look
print("/tmp contents:")
for name in sorted(os.listdir('/tmp')):
    full = os.path.join('/tmp', name)
    try:
        print(f"  {name}  ({os.path.getsize(full)} bytes)" if os.path.isfile(full) else f"  {name}/ (dir)")
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"  {name}  (unreadable: {e})")
